'''Feldrona''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LECG" /> located in the [[Feldrona system/Legends|Feldrona system]], a part of the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point, it was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by members of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from<ref name="LECG" /> the Glythe [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Iridonia">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Iridonia system/Legends|Iridonia system]]</ref> planet [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].<ref name="LECG" />

After its [[Attack on Emperor Fel|establishment]] in [[130 ABY]], several of Iridonia's seven colony worlds rebelled against the new dominance of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] ruled by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. In response, the Empire devastated two of the colonies via [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], and afterward, the remaining five worlds surrendered to [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]]. The [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Iridonia)|Sith Lord]] in charge of Iridonia and its colonies subsequently decreed that, as punishment for the colonies' betrayal, Feldrona be transformed into a tightly controlled Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world. The planet was then cordoned off and used to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] criminals.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feldrona was introduced in the sourcebook ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="LECG" /> on [[March 17]], [[2009]]<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/legacycampaignguide|text=''Legacy Campaign Guide''}}</ref> for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LECG" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Feldrona [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square J-7.<ref name="TEA" />
